description: Register a URL that receives bulk-job completion events, so scheduled or unattended workflows are notified instead of polling. Each event carries the job's results (emails, phone numbers or records) in its body. Free: this call never spends credits.

secret.description: Shared secret for HMAC signature verification.

url.description: URL that receives the events, http or https. The API refuses a host that resolves to a private or internal address.

name: create_webhook
title: Create a webhook (free)
